body:
## Outcome and current status

Consent presentation exists and document extraction already checks draft consent. Reconcile all included model paths behind one explicit policy so a screen or a second entry point cannot bypass permission.

Part of #817. This is an implementation candidate requiring a current path audit before work begins. No delivery milestone label is earned merely by filing it.

## Scope and entry points

ios/ArgusFoundation/ReleaseUI/Identity/ReleaseAIConsentView.swift; financial document extraction service; assigned chat/voice dispatch owners

Do not add unsupported claims about provider retention or erase already disclosed processing history. Paid/provider acceptance and new contracts retain their approval gates.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Inventory the actual personal-data flows and model providers for the selected launch features before choosing the shared consent contract.
- [ ] Reuse the current document consent guard. Define one authoritative policy and persisted/versioned consent semantics for all included dispatch paths.
- [ ] Block chat, document and any included voice transmission before explicit permission, including retries, background preparation and alternate entry points.
- [ ] Show accurate Spanish/English disclosure before transmission. Decline/cancel preserves local capture and drafts without initiating paid extraction.
- [ ] Prove with dispatch assertions that denied or missing consent produces no provider call. Verify allowed dispatch sends only authorized space data.
- [ ] Record the effect of a later consent change on subsequent requests. Reconcile policy copy and manifests with the privacy issue.

- [ ] Include memory embeddings and sensitivity-assessment/classifier calls in the provider-dispatch inventory, as well as chat, documents and any included voice. Inspect personalization_memory_index.py and personalization_memory_assessor.py; no alternate or background call may bypass consent or current space access.
- [ ] Keep permission to remember/use personal context distinct from consent to transmit data to a provider. Verify missing, declined or withdrawn consent prevents the affected dispatches, including retries. Define behavior for already-dispatched work without promising retroactive recall of transmitted data.

## Dependencies and parallel work

Consent design and deterministic tests can run alongside the runtime contract and document-storage work. Serialize the shared dispatch policy; avoid separate ad hoc guards.

Completion prerequisites: #818. Native blocked-by links record these same prerequisites. They gate completion, not useful preparation. Existing linked issues keep their own acceptance and approval boundaries.

## Verification and closure

Use the approved scope in #817. Before a completion claim, record the original/current integration SHAs, PR head, relevant API/build identity, environment and runtime mode. Retain durable evidence for happy path, interruption/recovery, authorization and relaunch where relevant. Use focused deterministic checks and the real affected journey; document non-applicable checks instead of inventing passes. Physical journeys use the shared Mac/device scheduler.

Apply implemented only after the full code scope lands. Apply verified only after the stated acceptance passes. Apply enabled only with approval and observed availability for a named environment/audience, or record activation as not applicable.

Any implementation requires its bounded assignment and approved contracts. Preserve default-off gates until authorized. Plan rollback at the changed owner; schema changes require backup and forward-recovery or rollback evidence before hosted execution. No merge, deployment, hosted mutation or paid provider run is authorized by this issue.

## Planning evidence

Reviewed 2026-10-04 CT against integration `76b6afcb4080c6e639e8c50bdabf51621d862190`, the current execution board, master plan and open issue inventory. This is repository/GitHub planning, not a new runtime acceptance result. Deployed API/web/workflow SHAs and live runtime mode are omitted because no hosted inspection was performed. Revalidate specific gaps at assignment time.
